title: Validating markers the lab's way
objective: Explain why RNAscope is central to defining DRG subtypes.

steps.title: From a cluster to a real cell
steps.body: Sequencing (C12) finds candidate marker genes for a subtype. But a cluster on a computer isn't a cell you can target. **[[RNAscope]]** puts those markers back in tissue: it shows the gene is really there, in real **[[DRG]]** neurons, and which markers co-occur.

steps.prompt: Sequencing says gene X marks a subtype. What does RNAscope add?
options: It shows X is really, spatially expressed in real neurons
It shows protein X is made in those same neurons
It proves X is needed for that subtype's function
It makes the earlier sequencing step entirely unnecessary
steps.explanation: RNAscope grounds a computational cluster in actual tissue, confirming the marker is expressed where the data predicted.

variants.setup: A sequencing cluster suggests a marker. You run RNAscope for it.
options: That the marker really is expressed in those neurons
That the marker protein is made in those neurons
That the marker is needed for those neurons' function
variants.reveal: RNAscope confirms the predicted marker is genuinely transcribed in the tissue.

steps.setup: The colon paper defines five DRG subtypes by marker genes (TrkB, TH, Bmpr1b, Sstr2, Adra2a).
steps.prompt: How would you confirm a subtype exists in tissue?
options: RNAscope for its marker genes in DRG sections
A western blot of homogenized DRG lysate
Bulk RNA-seq of whole dissected DRG
steps.reveal: Multiplex RNAscope shows each marker in DRG neurons and whether markers co-occur, grounding the subtype scheme in real cells.

variants.prompt: To show a marker-defined DRG subtype is real, you'd…

steps.title: Why it matters for your project
steps.body: Before you can silence pancreas afferents with a **[[DREADD]]**, you must know *which* neurons they are and that your **[[Cre]]** line hits them. RNAscope is how you check the marker is expressed in the right cells — the same logic, aimed at the pancreas.

sources.note: Uses RNAscope to confirm DRG subtype markers for colon afferents.
